```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

$log(-5)$

```{r}
Number_sign <- function(x)
{
  if(x>0)
    print(paste(x,"is greater than zero"))
  else
    print(paste(x,"is less than zero"))
}
Number_sign(-2)

```
```{r}
Number_sign2 <- function(x)
{
  if(is.na(x))
    print(paste(x,"is a missing value"))
  else if (x > 0)
    print(paste(x,"is greater than zero"))
  else if (x < 0)
    print(paste(x,"is less than zero"))
}
Number_sign3 <- Vectorize(Number_sign2)
Number_sign3(c(1,5,-5))
```
